body:
Scope: isolated preparatory Code Review of scripts/test-change-metadata-validator.py, only the three-line removal of the earlier shadowed test_valid_basic_fixture_passes definition. This assessment is separate from proposed compact-engine retirement and is not milestone/final whole-change approval for that future capability change.

Independent AST/source comparison confirms two same-class definitions before and one after. The later definition calls assertPathPasses(VALID_BASIC_FIXTURE); that constant is exactly FIXTURES / valid-basic / change.yaml, matching the removed body. Python class construction already overwrote the earlier definition. Comparing the effective name-to-function AST maps before and after yields exact equality, and 58 discovered test names remain. No fixture, assertion, runner, helper, production or other test change is present.

Checklist: requirement alignment pass (authorized duplicate reconciliation); protection/discovery pass (effective executable methods identical); edge/error/compatibility and safety pass (all effective definitions and fixtures preserved); architecture pass (no behavior boundary change); generated currency not affected; unrelated-scope pass; evidence adequacy pass for this bounded edit. Durable duplicate-reconciliation records full python scripts/test-change-metadata-validator.py execution with 116 tests passed and unchanged loader names. There is no executed-case reduction, runtime improvement or new oracle claim. AST comparison supplies an independent mechanism explanation rather than relying only on a green count.

The separately audited stale M4 activation assertion still fails in an unchanged module. That result is not concealed, fixed or attributed to this correction. Other four audited candidates remain unchanged. No material finding emerged for the exact preparatory correction. Approval applies only to this test-only edit; it grants no compact retirement, Design approval, final Verify, automatic routing or branch/PR readiness. Future changed engineering scope requires its own review.
independence_basis: Separate delegated reviewer /root/independent_proposal_review did not author this proposal or preparatory correction. Independently inspected exact subjects, actual existing implementation boundaries and evidence; writes only review judgments, not authoring or routing state.
